props.text: Edits the theme files on THIS gateway, live. It is not a build tool: the ten pre-packaged themes are generated from the repo, so Install on the first page puts them back and your edits to them go with it. Make one of your own and nothing overwrites it.

transforms.code:
import themepack
	theme = (value + '|').split('|')[0]
	if not theme:
		return ''
	kind = themepack.theme_kind(theme)
	base = themepack.base_of(theme)
	# Plain ASCII, and a sentence rather than dash-separated fragments.
	# A non-ASCII character in a Jython 2 str literal is BYTES, not a code
	# point: the separator here arrived on the page as mojibake.
	words = {
		'packaged': 'One of the ten pre-packaged themes, built on %s. Install on the first page puts it back.',
		'stock': "One of Ignition's own, built on %s. Editing it changes every project using it.",
		'user': 'Yours, built on %s. Nothing on the Installer page overwrites it.',
	}
	text = words.get(kind, kind)
	if '%s' in text:
		text = text % (base or 'a stock theme')
	return text

config.script:
import themepack
	theme = self.view.custom.theme
	try:
		if themepack.delete_theme(theme):
			self.view.custom.status = 'Deleted %s' % theme
		else:
			self.view.custom.status = 'There was no %s to delete' % theme
		# Land on another theme rather than on an empty picker: the
		# dropdown's default only evaluates once, so clearing it leaves
		# 'Select...' and an editor with nothing in it.
		rows = themepack.list_themes()
		mine = [r['id'] for r in rows if r['ours']]
		self.view.custom.theme = (mine or [r['id'] for r in rows] or [''])[0]
		self.view.custom.file = 'variables.css'
		self.view.custom.nudge = self.view.custom.nudge + 1
	except Exception, e:
		self.view.custom.status = str(e)

config.script:
import themepack
	name = (self.view.custom.new_name or '').strip()
	try:
		themepack.new_theme(name, self.view.custom.new_base)
		self.view.custom.new_name = ''
		self.view.custom.making = ''
		self.view.custom.theme = name
		self.view.custom.file = 'variables.css'
		self.view.custom.status = ('Created %s on %s -- it renders like its base until you change it'
		                           % (name, self.view.custom.new_base))
		self.view.custom.nudge = self.view.custom.nudge + 1
	except Exception, e:
		self.view.custom.status = str(e)

import themepack
	name = (self.view.custom.new_name or '').strip()
	source = self.view.custom.theme
	try:
		themepack.copy_theme(source, name)
		self.view.custom.new_name = ''
		self.view.custom.making = ''
		self.view.custom.theme = name
		self.view.custom.status = 'Copied %s to %s' % (source, name)
		self.view.custom.nudge = self.view.custom.nudge + 1
	except Exception, e:
		self.view.custom.status = str(e)

props.text: Click one to open it. A dot marks a file that no longer matches what the installer ships.
Saving writes it and runs a config scan, which is what makes the gateway use it. Undo my changes puts back what the installer ships for this one file.

config.expression: if({view.custom.file} = '', '-- pick a file on the left --', {view.custom.file})

config.script:
import themepack
	theme = self.view.custom.theme
	filename = self.view.custom.file
	if not filename:
		self.view.custom.status = 'Pick a file first'
		return
	try:
		result = themepack.write_file(theme, filename,
		                              self.view.custom.text)
		self.view.custom.status = ('Saved %s (%d bytes) and scanned'
		                           % (filename, result['bytes']))
		self.view.custom.nudge = self.view.custom.nudge + 1
	except Exception, e:
		self.view.custom.status = str(e)

import themepack
	filename = self.view.custom.file
	if not filename:
		self.view.custom.status = 'Pick a file first'
		return
	try:
		themepack.revert_file(self.view.custom.theme, filename)
		self.view.custom.status = ('Put back what the installer ships for %s'
		                           % filename)
		self.view.custom.nudge = self.view.custom.nudge + 1
	except Exception, e:
		self.view.custom.status = str(e)
